visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A dark-haired man in a black t-shirt sits still while a woman with her hair tied back, wearing a black crop top, carefully applies a white sheet mask onto his face. The indoor studio setting features dark wooden shelves filled with books and various framed certificates under warm, bright lighting. (2) The man talks directly to the camera while wearing the white facial mask, which covers his entire face except for his eyes and mouth. The camera cuts between a medium shot of him speaking and close-up inserts of the woman's hands smoothing the edges of the mask against his skin. (3) A blonde woman enters the frame holding a white product box labeled 'Bri.' in black text. She stands next to the man, who is now shown from the side as they discuss the product. The background remains the same studio office environment with visible light stands and equipment. (4) Extreme close-up shots show the unique thick, white texture of the facial mask being pulled and stretched by hands. A comparison image of cooked squid appears as an inset to illustrate the material's resemblance. The lighting remains bright, emphasizing the moisture and texture of the mask material. (5) The man, now wearing a black blazer over his t-shirt, looks directly at the camera and points his finger downward toward the bottom of the screen. He is framed in a medium close-up against a clean studio background. Large text overlays and a cartoon avatar appear near the end.
